create_entry.default: You're set. Use Assist as usual; you'll be told when there's something to review. Nothing in your home changes until you accept.

status.name: Recording status
status.description: Show recording status and compatibility limits.

export_recording.name: Export recording
export_recording.description: Return one recording as JSON. Includes household conversations; administrators only.

analyze_recording.name: Analyze recording (journey analyzer)
analyze_recording.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: sends one recording's compact digest to the configured AI Task and returns the journeys it finds, in the label format. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

full.name: Full analysis
full.description: Skip the quick check and always run the full analysis.

generate_hypotheses.name: Generate hypotheses (hypothesis generator)
generate_hypotheses.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: sends analyzed sessions to the configured AI Task, which groups their friction into themes and proposes one change per theme. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

analyses.name: Analyzes
analyses.description: Analyzed sessions, as Analyze recording returns them.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

seeded.name: Seeded cases
seeded.description: Optional, for testing the reviewer: named hypotheses it reviews after the generator finishes.

review_hypothesis.name: Review hypothesis (reviewer)
review_hypothesis.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: the configured AI Task keeps, revises or drops one hypothesis and flags likely regressions. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

hypothesis.name: Hypothesis
hypothesis.description: One hypothesis, as Generate hypotheses returns them.

analyses.name: Analyzes
analyses.description: The analyzed sessions the review checks against.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

check_replay_fidelity.name: Check replay fidelity
check_replay_fidelity.description: Rebuild a recorded conversation's home in a sandbox and compare Assist's system prompt and tools there with the recorded ones. No AI model is called.

replay_recording.name: Replay a recording
replay_recording.description: Replay a recorded conversation's first turns with the assistant it used, in a sandbox, and report whether the assistant changed the same devices the same way. Calls that assistant's AI model; nothing is stored.

last_turn.name: Last turn
last_turn.description: Replay up to this user turn (the first by default).

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: each turn is one or more calls to the assistant's model.

test_hypotheses.name: Test hypotheses
test_hypotheses.description: Replay recorded conversations with each hypothesis's changes, on every goal it names, in a sandbox where devices are simulated; up to the tests-per-goal setting for each goal. Can cost money with your AI providers.

analyses.name: Analyzes
analyses.description: The journey analyzes the hypotheses were built from.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: replays call your assistant's AI model.

per_goal.name: Tests per goal
per_goal.description: How many fixes each goal may be tested with, in each conversation where it came up; defaults to the tests-per-goal setting.

list_improvements.name: List improvements
list_improvements.description: The tested improvements, with their status, tests and decisions. Makes no AI requests and changes nothing.

quick_check.name: Quick check (calibration)
quick_check.description: Run only the quick check on some recordings, with a chosen model, to calibrate it. Can cost a little with your AI provider; nothing else runs.

entity_id.name: Model
entity_id.description: The AI Task to check with; defaults to the quick-check model in Settings.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: each recording is one call to the model.

write_summaries.name: Write summaries
write_summaries.description: A small AI model writes each improvement's headline and what you get, in plain words (those without one, or the ones given). Can cost a little with your AI provider.

improvement_ids.name: Improvements
improvement_ids.description: Improvement IDs; leave empty for every improvement without a summary.

entity_id.name: Model
entity_id.description: The AI Task to write with; defaults to the quick-check model, else the follow-up check model, else the main one.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: each improvement is one short call to the model.
